description: From Earth's raw elements to the infinite cosmos, Voyager 1 and 2 carry humanity's essence into the eternal dark. Bounded by aluminum, gold, and copper, these probes captured the outer worlds before crossing into interstellar space. Trailing the famous Golden Records, they journey as silent messengers of a distant blue world. Eons from now, their cosmic voyage will come full circle, returning to the stellar cradles to reunite with the very same ancient star-dust that once birthed them.
